issue.title: Can't find CURLConfig.cmake for mavsdk-windows-x64-release
issue.body:
I'm trying to install MAVSDK library on Windows x64
I'm following the instructions under MAVSDK QuickStart (https://mavsdk.mavlink.io/main/en/cpp/quickstart.html)
I'm currently stuck on the "Build and Try Example" step

I entered the following (in a Command Prompt):
D:\MAVSDK\examples\takeoff_and_land>cmake -Bbuild -DCMAKE_PREFIX_PATH=d:/mavsdk-windows-x64-release -DCURL_DIR=D:\vcpkg\installed\x86-windows\share\curl -DCMAKE_TOOLCHAIN_FILE=D:/vcpkg/scripts/buildsystems/vcpkg.cmake -H.

I get the following output:
-- Selecting Windows SDK version 10.0.22621.0 to target Windows 10.0.22000.
CMake Error at C:/Program Files/CMake/share/cmake-3.23/Modules/CMakeFindDependencyMacro.cmake:47 (find_package):
  Could not find a configuration file for package "CURL" that is compatible
  with requested version "".

  The following configuration files were considered but not accepted:

    D:/vcpkg/installed/x86-windows/share/curl/CURLConfig.cmake, version: 7.84.0-DEV (32bit)

Call Stack (most recent call first):
  D:/mavsdk-windows-x64-release/lib/cmake/MAVSDK/MAVSDKConfig.cmake:7 (find_dependency)
  CMakeLists.txt:12 (find_package)

Note that I set the following in the command, because earlier attempts indicated that it needs CURLConfig.cmake, and that's the only directory where I found it
-DCURL_DIR=D:\vcpkg\installed\x86-windows\share\curl

I'm guessing that I need CURLConfig.cmake (or a substitute) under D:\vcpkg\installed\x64-windows\share, but I'm not sure and don't know how to get or generate it.

Any suggestions for what to try next?


So it somehow wants version "", and it finds version 7.84.0-DEV.

It's weird because the [CMake docs](https://cmake.org/cmake/help/latest/command/find_package.html#config-mode-version-selection) say:

> When the [version] argument is given, Config mode will only find a version of the package that claims compatibility with the requested version (see [format specification](https://cmake.org/cmake/help/latest/command/find_package.html#find-package-version-format)).

So I would expect that `""` means that the `[version]` argument was not given :thinking:.

Anyway can you try to find the [`MAVSDKConfig.cmake`](https://github.com/mavlink/MAVSDK/blob/main/src/MAVSDKConfig.cmake.in#L7) file in your installation and set a version there (I would try with "7"), to see if that helps?

So something like (assuming you have a CMake version >= 3.9.0):

```
find_dependency(CURL 7 REQUIRED CONFIG)
```

The cmake output says that the CURLConfig.cmake I'm using is "version: 7.84.0-DEV (32bit)".

Comments at the top of CURLConfig.cmake indicate that it was autogenerated from curl-config.cmake.in. I have a version of curl-config.cmake.in (just one, which is in D:\curl\CMake).
